text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After training, Sakura Laurel was reading
letters from her fans.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: —"I gave up on running because of my weak legs, but seeing Laurel-san made me want to try again. I'll keep cheering for you," it says.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, they even included a photo.
Look—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The photo I received showed an elementary-school-aged
Umamusume girl running.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
That's a great photo, isn't it?
...Yeah, I've got to do my best too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Sakura Laurel spent a while happily looking over the letters and photos again.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The next day, on our way back from scouting a new running course with Sakura Laurel—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Huh...?
The girl running over there, could it be...

text_block_list.name: Little Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Wah, I did it! I ran longer than last time!
...Whoops, gotta remember to check my legs...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I knew it! Look, Trainer!
It's the girl from the fan letter photo!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
She's so full of life...
You can't even tell she has a handicap with her leg!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I see, so this is where you're always working hard...!
That's amazing...
choice_data_list: You don't want to say anything to them?
Aren't you going to call out to them?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: More than that, I want to show her that I'm doing my best too!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: I need to... run even better...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
So please, keep supporting me...
with training and races!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, well then, let's head back!
...And since we're at it, let's run!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Sakura Laurel jogged back toward Tracen Academy with light, nimble steps!
